description: This Java class 'EcuStimulator' provides functionality for testing and building tables for an ECU (Engine Control Unit) simulator, including measurement collection, parameter setting, and UI integration.

classes.name: EcuStimulator
classes.description: Main class for ECU stimulation, measurement, and table generation with UI integration.

classes.name: EcuStimulator.MultipleMeasurements
classes.description: Helper class to store multiple dwell and advance measurements.

methods.name: buildTable
methods.description: Generates measurement data over RPM and engine load ranges, logs results, and writes data as C array.

methods.name: buildTable
methods.description: Iterates over RPM, engine load, and coolant temperature to test points.

methods.name: testPoint
methods.description: Sets parameters, waits for measurements, processes results, and invokes result listener.

methods.name: sleepRuntime
methods.description: Pauses thread execution for specified milliseconds.

methods.name: setRpm
methods.description: Requests RPM change and verifies actual RPM.

methods.name: setPotVoltage
methods.description: Adjusts potentiometer voltage via hardware commands, with retries.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs messages to central message system and file log.

methods.name: putValue
methods.description: Formats message string with delimiter and value.

methods.name: createButton
methods.description: Creates a UI button to trigger table building in a separate thread.

methods.name: waitForMultipleResults
methods.description: Collects multiple dwell and advance measurements asynchronously.
